summary: Completed backend regression, API enhancement checks, production build, and authenticated desktop/mobile UI testing. Core auth, field editor, analysis history, PDF download, chart, CRUD UI, and mobile overflow flows passed.

critical.issue: History endpoint filters only by field_id and does not verify owner_id, so any authenticated user who guesses another field ID can read its analyses.

minor.issue: Preloaded North Meadow field response has no geometry_source metadata, while newly created fields do.
Polygon validation only enforces at least three points; it does not validate numeric coordinate ranges, polygon closure, or non-self-intersection.

action_items: Add owner_id filtering/authorization to field analysis history.
Backfill geometry_source on startup for existing/seeded fields.
Add strict polygon coordinate/ring validity checks before geodesic calculation.
Consider replacing wildcard CORS_ORIGINS with explicit configured origins when credentials are enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT is stored in browser localStorage and login does not set an httpOnly cookie; this does not meet the auth playbook's httpOnly-cookie check.
The frontend's report/history calls are not wrapped in catch handlers, so a backend failure can produce an unhandled rejected promise without a user-facing error state.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 existing pytest tests; enhancement smoke passed)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data; used preloaded admin@example.com and North Meadow · DEMO field. One analysis was persisted during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login, dashboard, field editor open/edit/cancel, analysis, history chart, PDF download, mobile 390px overflow, and production build passed. DEMO SAR imagery/mask, DEMO weather, ESTIMATED/DEMO soil, algorithmic crop recommendation/readiness, and DEMO seed analysis remain MOCKED by design. Previous mobile logout issue remains in prior report and was not retested in this run.
rca of the issue: Seed initialization inserts the demo field without geometry_source, whereas POST /api/fields adds it. GET analyses queries only field_id without joining or checking the authenticated owner's field. Auth implementation uses bearer tokens in localStorage and has no cookie/session lockout implementation.
